const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; globalThis.__p04 = { panels: JSON.stringify(root.panels ?? null) }; root.panels = { ...(root.panels ?? {}), suggestions: { x: 1480, y: 40, w: 410, h: 320 }, journal: { x: 1480, y: 370, w: 410, h: 300 }, 'stat-sheet': { x: 1480, y: 680, w: 410, h: 180 } }; const openPlay = async () => { const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')) document.querySelector('#so-drawer .drawer-toggle')?.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-play'); i += 1) await wait(150); const tab = [...document.querySelectorAll('#so-workspace-modal .so-workspace-context button')].find((b) => b.textContent.trim() === 'This story'); if (tab && tab.getAttribute('aria-pressed') !== 'true') { tab.click(); await wait(300); } document.querySelector('#so-workspace-page-play')?.click(); await wait(400); }; const launch = async (id) => { const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); if (!document.querySelector(id)) await openPlay(); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector(id); i += 1) await wait(150); const opener = document.querySelector(id); if (!opener) throw new Error('no opener ' + id); opener.click(); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]'); i += 1) await wait(100); if (document.querySelector('#so-workspace-modal[open]')) throw new Error('the workspace stayed open over the panel from ' + id); }; await launch('#so-open-stat-sheet'); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !(document.querySelector('#so-stat-sheet')?.textContent ?? '').includes('Resolve'); i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); const sheet = document.querySelector('#so-stat-sheet')?.textContent ?? ''; if (!sheet.includes('Resolve')) throw new Error('stat sheet: ' + sheet.slice(0, 200)); await launch('#so-open-journal'); for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('#so-journal'); i += 1) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); const journal = document.querySelector('#so-journal')?.textContent ?? ''; if (!journal.includes("The ferryman's debt")) throw new Error('journal: ' + journal.slice(0, 200)); await launch('#so-open-suggestions'); if (document.querySelectorAll('#so-sheet').length !== 1) throw new Error('one story sheet expected, saw ' + document.querySelectorAll('#so-sheet').length); let lines = []; for (let i = 0; i < 60 && lines.length < 3; i += 1) { await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); lines = [...document.querySelectorAll('#so-suggestions [data-so="suggestion"]')].map((b) => b.textContent.trim()); } const want = ['I ask the ferryman what I owe him.', 'I look for a way over the wall.', 'Who else is waiting for the ferry?', 'I count my coins.']; if (JSON.stringify(lines) !== JSON.stringify(want)) throw new Error('suggestions shown: ' + JSON.stringify(lines)); for (const leak of ['The rooftops', 'SO-HIDDEN-QUEST-TITLE', 'SO-HIDDEN-STEP', 'SO-AUTHOR-NOTE', 'SO-SECRET-MILESTONE']) if (document.querySelector('#so-panels-root').textContent.includes(leak)) throw new Error('leak in the panels: ' + leak); return lines;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const box = document.querySelector('#send_textarea'); box.value = ''; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); const before = ctx.chat.length; document.querySelector('#so-suggestions [data-so="suggestion"]').click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1200)); if (box.value !== 'I ask the ferryman what I owe him.') throw new Error('box after the click: ' + JSON.stringify(box.value)); if (ctx.chat.length !== before) throw new Error('a suggestion click changed the chat: ' + before + ' -> ' + ctx.chat.length); box.value = 'my own words'; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); document.querySelectorAll('#so-suggestions [data-so="suggestion"]')[1].click(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 300)); const kept = box.value; box.value = ''; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); if (kept !== 'my own words') throw new Error('a suggestion overwrote what the player typed: ' + JSON.stringify(kept)); return { filled: true, kept };
